questions.stem: A, B, C, D, E, and F are members of a family. B is the son of C but C is not the mother of B. A and C are a married couple. E is the brother of C. D is the daughter of A. F is the brother of B. How many total male members are there in the family?
questions.explanation: B is the son of C (B is male). C is not the mother, so C is the father (C is male). A and C are married, so A is the mother (female). E is the brother of C (E is male).
